title: Expedition frame body
description: One frame of an expedition (register row DK1740; spec-delta S1597): the hash of the frame, the action, the GPU milliseconds and the hash of the frame before it (`genesis` for the first), so a frame cannot be dropped or reordered. Signed by the operator. The log refuses a frame out of order (expedition_frame_order), one that does not follow the hash of the last (expedition_chain_broken), one past the step limit (expedition_step_limit) and one that would take the cost over the cap (expedition_cost_cap); the frame that reaches the cap is the last, and the expedition can then only close void. Chain: none (prev is null).
